method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: Prohibited Conduct includes 'other conduct which, in the sole discretion of TradeDay, represents uncommercial activity, is intended to game the market, or otherwise is not a viable trading strategy'; TradeDay may then 'remove any Simulated Account profits, delete a trading day, reset an Account, or ban a User'.
Trading Rules 'are subject to change by TradeDay in its sole and absolute discretion from time to time' and 'remain subject to change at any time'; the user must stay current.
Funded SIM and Funded Live accounts 'are governed by a separate agreement between the User and TradeDay' (the 'Funded SIM Account Agreement that you execute'), not published with the terms.
